"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Gang membership should be a deportable offense.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Any previously deported illegal alien who continues to show a lack of respect for borders and rule of law must be penalized.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for stiffer penalties, such as a mandatory minimum sentence of five years, for any illegal alien who illegally re-enters the nation after already having been deported.",
